visibility.0: The landmark is occluded, outside the image, or its anatomical location cannot be judged reliably.
visibility.1: The landmark is visible and its coordinate has been checked by a human reviewer.
visibility.null: Automatic preannotation only; visibility has not been reviewed. This record is not ground truth.

coordinate_quality.reliable_estimate: Occluded point whose location can be reasonably inferred from visible facial structure; correct the coordinate before marking it occluded.
coordinate_quality.uncertain: Occluded, out-of-frame, or otherwise unlocalizable point; its coordinate must not be treated as a training target.

annotation_policy: Keep all 28 positions. Visibility 0 denotes an occluded or non-visible point, regardless of whether its location can be estimated. If an occluded location can be reasonably inferred, correct its coordinate and set coordinate_quality to reliable_estimate. Otherwise set coordinate_quality to uncertain; retain the coordinate only as a placeholder. Do not infer visibility or coordinate quality from heatmap confidence. NME uses visibility-1 points only. Compare training with reliable estimated occluded coordinates against training with all visibility-0 coordinates excluded, using the same fixed split. The review UI converts remaining null visibility values to 1 only on an explicit per-image save after inspection. Keep model confidence in a separate field. Test records require human review.
